name: Gatha
description: One of Urza's geneticists, who defects and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.

description_citations.text: "Urza's Destiny". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha appears to create an Orgg around 3863 AR during the War with Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: appears to show the creation of an Orgg by Gatha around 3863 AR

citation.text: "Orgg", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha's experiments transform Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest being Kreig.
timeline.quote: His experiments transformed the Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest of which was the witch-king Kreig .

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha throws himself off a cliff rather than let the Phyrexians learn his secrets.
timeline.quote: The researcher threw himself off a cliff to prevent the Phyrexians from discovering his secrets.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha's unauthorized experiments lead to his expulsion; he continues in Keld, creating Kreig, which Phyrexia notices.
timeline.quote: he continued his project in Keld , ultimately creating Kreig , which was powerful enough to get noticed by Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Metathran", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha boasts that the academy educates and he employs.

citation.text: Treachery (Urza's Destiny, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gatha increases his subjects' stature but not their lifespans.
timeline.quote: Gatha showed remarkable prowess in increasing his subjects' stature.

citation.text: Twisted Experiment (Urza's Destiny, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gatha falls and is called to account for his abominations.
timeline.quote: When Gatha fell, he was called to account for each abomination he created.

citation.text: Aether Sting (Urza's Destiny, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gatha experiments with splicing Phyrexian DNA into test subjects and is expelled, continuing in Keld.
timeline.quote: While he was found out and expelled, he continued his project in Keld .

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Gatha's Research". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kreig seizes power in Keld with Gatha at his side; Croag starts a war to retrieve the research, and Gatha and Kreig jump off a cliff to keep their knowledge from Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gatha and Kreig jumped off a cliff to keep their knowledge and genetic potential out of Phyrexia's reach

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Gatha's Research". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza's geneticist Gatha defects and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.
timeline.quote: One of his geneticists, Gatha , defects, and uses his knowledge to improve the Keldon race.

citation.text: "Urza's Destiny", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha abandoned the project at Tolaria and stole resources to begin his own experiments.
timeline.quote: Gatha to abandon the project in Tolaria entirely and steal enough resources to begin his own experiments

citation.text: "Gatha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha's genetic tampering enhanced the Keldons and led to the Witch-kings.
timeline.quote: Gatha's genetic tampering enhanced the Keldons into nightmarish warriors

citation.text: "Gatha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gatha blew up his lab and cast himself off a cliff to keep his knowledge from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gatha, sensing the grave danger he had put Urza's bloodlines project in, blew up his lab and cast himself off a cliff

citation.text: "Gatha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Gatha took part in the Bloodline project under Barrin's supervision

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Gatha's Research". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Gatha gained the support of the Doyen Kreyohl and was able to carry out his work in peace.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
